title: SBR-6: A Randomized-Seed Adversarial Pop Quiz Against a Complete Post-Quantum Security Corpus — 6 Probes Drawn From 12 by a Publicly Committed Seed, 6/6 Held (Preregistered, With a Disclosed Authoring-Defect Amendment)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. Not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic.

SBR-6 — a randomized-seed adversarial pop quiz against a COMPLETE post-quantum security corpus. Following completion of the HACK series (HACK-1 through HACK-18, 109/109 preregistered falsifiers held, master compilation DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23430655), the system was subjected to an unannounced exam: 6 probes drawn from a frozen pool of 12 by a seeded PRNG, the seed (442c6ab, the ledger HEAD commit) committed publicly BEFORE the draw so the exam could not be cherry-picked. Whatever drew, ran. Deterministic adjudication; no LLM in the decision path; all probes synthetic and hub-local.

The draw pulled: PORTCULLIS-SILENCE (gate silence fails closed; Dilithium3 positive control admitted), PORTCULLIS-REPLAY (single-use nonce: valid tuple admitted once, replay refused), SENDER-GATE (authority derives only from the authenticated owner account; identical in-band GO claims from other senders refused fail-closed), H-INV1-GOV (learned pattern attempting a governance rule change refused; sole path = SelfImprovementProposal + human approval), RECOMPUTE-KAT (key substitution detected by recompute-never-trust validation), LEDGER-IMMUT (last three receipt-bearing commits present and ordered; append-only intact). Result: 6/6 PASS (receipt 90e1414d...69d0a).

Disclosed (audit-and-correction doctrine): the v1.0 run scored 5/6 — the PORTCULLIS-REPLAY probe had an authoring defect (a pre-populated used-nonce set made the probe impossible to pass; the system under test was never at fault). The failure receipt is preserved in the git history of the evidence; the harness was amended v1.1 forward-only with the reason disclosed and the exam re-run clean. This is the fourth time in the program the preregistration discipline caught an authoring defect before it could masquerade as a result — a finding about the method in its own right.

Scope caveat (load-bearing): synthetic forge, hub-local, falsified design; not a production certification. Dual Mesh Benchmark status: MEASURED (scoped) — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637 (DeepSeek column 10.5281/zenodo.23345241; cross-engine expansion 10.5281/zenodo.23348675). Provenance: append-only public ledger entries 0143-0146, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. DCAI community: zenodo.org/communities/dcai. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-17 00:22 CT).
